description: List the wears (perfume of the day) logged on the user's own Parfumo account over a period, most recent first. Default period: the current month and the two before it; a call covers 12 calendar months at most (one request per month). Returns each wear with its `wear_id`, perfume, date and personal note. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: the `next_cursor` of the previous response.

from.description: First day of the period, "YYYY-MM-DD". Default: the first day of the month two months before `to`.

limit.description: Maximum number of wears to return (default 25, maximum 100).

to.description: Last day of the period, "YYYY-MM-DD". Default: today (UTC). A period spans 12 calendar months at most.

name: parfumo_list_wears

Wear.description: One logged wear ("perfume of the day").

comment.description: The member's own note on this wear.

perfume_id.description: Perfume identifier usable with every perfume tool (`Brand/Perfume`).

wear_id.description: Identifier of the wear, to pass to parfumo_delete_wear.

worn_at.description: Local date and time of the wear as shown by Parfumo (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the following wears. Absent when there is nothing more.

total_in_period.description: Number of wears in the period.
